content.text:
Here's how it went:

I'd put the 750 ₪ a month into the fund the page marks as cheapest, "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", and hold it in a securities account at "פסגות ניירות ערך בע"מ". After 15 years that comes to about **179,889 ₪**. I put in 135,000 ₪ of my own money. I'm fairly sure about this. What decided it was the big box marked "הבחירה שלכם · ★ הזול" at the top of the results.

**What it assumes about inflation:** 2% a year. Next to the result it says "בכסף של היום", so I take the 179,889 to already be in today's shekels. It also assumes 7% a year growth, which is the default I left alone. And it assumes "אם הדולר לא זז מול השקל" (the dollar stays where it is against the shekel), with the dollar at 3.17 ₪. I didn't change any of those.

**How it went:**
- **First screen:** the heading "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן" was exactly my thing, and S&P 500 was already picked.
- **My numbers:** I typed 0 for "סכום היום", 750 a month and 15 years. The 750 field is right, but the slider under it shows 800, which looks odd. When I changed the numbers the boxes jumped around a bit.
- **Inflation:** I clicked "אינפלציה". A pop-up opened with "אינפלציה בשנה 2%" and the note "פרמטר של האתר". I closed it.
- **Scrolling down:**
  - The second option, "הזוג הבא בתור", is also Pesagot and ends up only 122 ₪ lower (179,766), so it hardly matters which one I pick.
  - There's a coloured bar chart called "כמה זה עולה לכם ב־15 שנים". The biggest pink part is tax, 15,364 ₪, which surprised me. The total cost is 18,299 ₪.
  - Then the cards for Pesagot and the Yelin Lapidot fund. Pesagot I know from ads. Yelin Lapidot I'm less sure about, but it's an investment house.
- **Skipped:** the filter chips under "כל הקרנות על מדד S&P 500", the fee buttons and the rest of the page further down.

**Words I didn't get:** "דמי משמרת", "נאמן", "צוברת", "עסקת החלף", "מנוטרלת מט״ח", "העמלות זו על זו", "4D".

I never got bored enough to close the page. The 750-vs-800 slider and the jumping boxes annoyed me a bit.
